name: collar_mixed_consideration_with_assumed_debt_and_earnout
question_template: Use exact arithmetic. Acquirer A offers each Target T share {CASH} USD in cash plus {RATIO} A shares, subject to a collar: if A's closing price is at least {LOWER} USD and at most {UPPER} USD, the exchange ratio of {RATIO} is fixed; if the closing price is strictly below {LOWER} USD, the ratio adjusts so the stock component per T share is worth {RATIO} times {LOWER} USD; if strictly above {UPPER} USD, the ratio adjusts so the stock component per T share is worth {RATIO} times {UPPER} USD. A's closing price is {PRICE} USD. T has {SHARES} million fully diluted shares, and A assumes T's net debt of {DEBT} million USD at closing. A contingent earnout is paid in cash exactly one year after closing: it equals 50 percent of T's first-year EBITDA in excess of a 100 million USD hurdle, capped at 60 million USD, and is zero if EBITDA does not exceed the hurdle. First-year EBITDA is {EBITDA} million USD. Discount the earnout to closing at 8 percent per year with annual compounding. Total transaction value at closing equals equity consideration (cash plus stock value across all T shares) plus assumed net debt plus the discounted earnout. Report the total transaction value in million USD.

slots.description: Exchange ratio actually applied after the collar adjustment.
Cash plus stock value across all target shares at closing.
Capped earnout discounted one year back to closing.

program:
def solve():
    cash = Fraction(P["CASH"])
    ratio = Fraction(P["RATIO"])
    lower = Fraction(P["LOWER"])
    upper = Fraction(P["UPPER"])
    price = Fraction(P["PRICE"])
    shares = Fraction(P["SHARES"])
    debt = Fraction(P["DEBT"])
    ebitda = Fraction(P["EBITDA"])
    if upper <= lower:
        raise ValueError("collar upper bound must exceed lower bound")
    if price < lower:
        eff = ratio * lower / price
    elif price > upper:
        eff = ratio * upper / price
    else:
        eff = ratio
    per_share = cash + eff * price
    equity = shares * per_share
    excess = ebitda - Fraction(100)
    if excess <= 0:
        earnout = Fraction(0)
    else:
        earnout = min(Fraction(1, 2) * excess, Fraction(60))
    pv_earnout = earnout / Fraction(108, 100)
    total = equity + debt + pv_earnout
    return {
        "final": total,
        "effective_exchange_ratio": eff,
        "equity_consideration": equity,
        "earnout_present_value": pv_earnout,
    }
